source.paper: none: Dogstar bar flyer, Brixton, London (designer Jeffrey Disastronaut)

summary: A club flyer laid out as a back-of-comic-book ad page: pink paper, black ink, a woodtype-style DOGSTAR masthead, scissor-cut dashed coupons, and pasted vintage mail-order ads (X-Ray Specs, Radio Hat, Make $100 $200 per week, Exploding Army Hand Deejays).

frame.masthead: Address line in heavy grotesque caps, DOGSTAR in huge outlined tuscan woodtype, 'in 4-D!' in the same face.

headers.notes: Outlined Tuscan/circus woodtype with a drop shadow.

units.notes: Tiny boxed ads with line-art cut, a hook headline, coupon text and a price; dense small type.
Dashed border with a scissors glyph at corners; stacked heavy caps lines of mixed sizes.

units.example: HAVE YOUR PARTY HERE! THE DOGSTAR IS THE PERFECT VENUE...
units.notes: Slab head over typewriter caps body in a double-ruled box.

type.look: Cooper-like soft slab ('WE serve hot 12" pizza!')

ornaments: line-art cuts (cow butchery chart, chef, grenade)
notes: Not a real classifieds page, but the comic-book mail-order look (X-Ray Specs, Sea-Monkeys era) is a distinct, beloved ad style worth a family of its own.
